content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Warner Robins

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: Verify you meet PMI's education and project-management experience requirements for the PMP credential. Most candidates combine a bachelor's degree with several years of directed project work, or equivalent alternatives. Review PMI's official eligibility matrix to confirm your profile qualifies before enrolling.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP course. Our Warner Robins cohorts are scheduled to fit working professionals' calendars. You'll cover the PMBOK Guide framework, exam domains, and real-world application—all required for PMI's official 35-hour credential.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After course completion, submit your formal application directly to PMI, including proof of education, experience, and Granite PM Academy's training confirmation. Pay the examination fee to PMI and await approval. Processing typically allows you to schedule your exam within weeks.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources—practice tests, study guides, and instructor office hours—to reinforce your knowledge. Schedule your computer-delivered PMP exam at a Pearson VUE testing center. You'll have four hours to demonstrate mastery of project-management domains and scenarios.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: After passing, you'll earn the PMP mark for a three-year cycle. Maintain your credential by earning Professional Development Units (PDUs) through PMI-approved activities, training, and contributions. Renew with PMI at the end of your cycle to keep your certification active and current.

fq_items.answer: PMI requires either a four-year degree with 36 months of project leadership experience, or a high school diploma with 60 months of experience. All applicants need 35 contact hours of PM education — our course satisfies this requirement.
